kind: QT3 fixture transport correction; no engine or XPath semantic adoption
affectedSections: QT3 environment collection/source file attribute versus uri attribute
intent: Represent existing local collection file fixtures as explicit absolute file URIs before passing them to EvaluationContext. Preserve URI-valued members and all runtime/resource policy behavior.
versionDecision: Keep unpublished release targets 1.81.2 and 0.2.6; this patch changes test harness transport only, not shipping engine or public API.
